hook: After learning alien sound categories, experts' auditory cortex favors the informative frequency band.
summary: Listeners who became expert at sorting synthetic alien sounds showed stronger fMRI responses to the frequency band that carried the identity cues, even when those cues stopped mattering. That bias matched the pattern seen when people deliberately attend to one tone band. The result comes from a small lab task with artificial sounds, so it may not carry over to speech or music.
title: Category learning drives cortical attentional gain to diagnostic dimensions of perceptual information.
